nms.name: Aurix
nms.notes: Aggro colorless (grey-eye) statues to pop. Appears across waves with phase-dependent drops.

nms.name: Impish Golem
nms.notes: Mid-boss atop the palace stairs. +30min time on defeat.

nms.name: Obstatrix
nms.notes: Zone boss near Mog House; spawns after Impish Golem. +30min on defeat.

nms.name: Disjoined Mithra
nms.notes: Disjoined Boss near zone to Upper Jeuno (H-10); spawns after Obstatrix. 'Judge, Jury and Executioner' title.
